name: Tomona ~Watashi to Furousha no Oji-san no Kouryuu Jikan~
original_name: 智奈 ～私と浮浪者のおじさんの交流時間～
source:
Main heroine leads a normal school life with friends, but she is missing something... On her way to school she goes past homeless bums. She is confused, but also interested... And these guys are happy to make an acquaintance.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
